title: Glowing teapot
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' xmlns:xlink='http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD54F' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD54F' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='potGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFB74D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E65100'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lidGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE082'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFA726'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='steamGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE0B2' stop-opacity='0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFE0B2' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='32' fill='#FFC107' opacity='0.08'/>

  <!-- Steam -->
  <path d='M38 28 Q34 22 38 16 Q42 10 38 4' stroke='url(#steamGrad)' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 26 Q46 19 50 13 Q54 7 50 1' stroke='url(#steamGrad)' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 28 Q58 22 62 16 Q66 10 62 4' stroke='url(#steamGrad)' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d='M20 55 L8 45 Q5 43 7 40 L12 38 Q15 37 17 40 L25 50 Z' fill='#FFB74D' stroke='#FFCC80' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d='M76 48 Q92 48 92 62 Q92 76 76 76' stroke='#FFCC80' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 48 Q90 48 90 62 Q90 74 76 76' stroke='#E65100' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Teapot body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='22' fill='url(#potGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='28' ry='16' fill='#FFB74D' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='56' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFE0B2' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Lid rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='20' ry='5' fill='#FFA726' stroke='#FFE082' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Lid dome -->
  <path d='M32 40 Q32 28 50 28 Q68 28 68 40 Z' fill='url(#lidGrad)' stroke='#FFCC80' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Lid knob -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='4' fill='#FFE082' stroke='#FFF8E1' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Spout highlight -->
  <path d='M14 42 Q12 43 14 45' stroke='#FFE0B2' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='24' ry='5' fill='#E65100' stroke='#FFA726' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='83' rx='22' ry='3' fill='#FFB74D' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- Decorative dots on body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='66' r='2' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='2' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='2' fill='#FFE082' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E1' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E1' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='50' r='1' fill='#FFF8E1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='58' r='1' fill='#FFF8E1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='20' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8E1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='16' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8E1' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
